phone_ui_info_note: Set false to stop outbound phone UI info (/api/agents + idea rows). OAuth/controls/balances still work. Restart phone_bridge after change.
phone_refresh_note: While phone_bridge runs: rebuild/publish dashboard+agents every N minutes all hours (not RTH-only). When E*TRADE session is expired, held-lot marks are overlaid from Yahoo so the phone is not frozen on the last broker book. Restart phone_bridge after change.
features_note: phone_bridge v1.5+ exposes GET /api/features and dashboard.shared_api so the E*TRADE phone app stays aligned: one shared API (keys/sandbox/tokens/account), independent practice mode per sleeve.
